title: Prospectivity micro-lens: adoption diagnostic & model-supply interlock
creator: Ethan Liu
description:
Problem statement: Sales and Solutions Engineering are losing time qualifying vendor/model fit for latency-sensitive verticals. We need a repeatable diagnostic that blends telemetry signals from Redwood Console with lightweight buyer interviews to produce actionable prospectivity scores and a model-supply interlock (mapping which vendors/models are operationally compatible, cost-feasible, and likely to be substituted).

Goal: Deliver a reproducible diagnostic and playbook that produces: (1) prospectivity micro-lens reports for three target verticals (finserv, healthcare SaaS, and ecommerce personalization), (2) a lightweight competitor/variant interoperability map focused on embeddings, quantization tolerance, and rollout risk, and (3) a prioritized ops checklist for sales/SEs to validate model swap feasibility during procurement conversations.

Why this is unique: unlike our broad model-scout artifacts, this ticket produces an integrated view that ties per-customer telemetry (token distribution, 95th pct latency contours, request sparsity) to procurement signals (SLA tolerance, data residency constraints, encryption needs) and competitor technical deltas (embedding dims, API contract quirks). The output is structured for quick go/no-go decisions at the field level.
acceptance_criteria: Three vertical-specific prospectivity micro-lens PDFs (<= 6 slides each) with telemetry-backed scoring for latency, cost sensitivity, and model quality risk.

A model-supply interlock matrix (CSV) mapping ~25 competitor model variants to compatibility attributes: embedding format, quantization availability, streaming support, regional availability, and estimated swap cost.
A 5-step SE playbook (markdown) with checks, telemetry queries, and fallback decision tree that fits into a 15-minute discovery call.
Field beta with two Sales accounts resulting in at least one documented procurement decision influenced by the playbook (notes linked).
tasks: Define telemetry queries and dashboards (work with Eng/Console): token histograms, p95 latency by route, embedding size distribution.
Run telemetry extraction for a 90-day window for target vertical cohorts (Data team: +ENG-6123).
Conduct 6 buyer interviews across three verticals to validate willingness-to-switch thresholds and SLA tolerances (Research lead: Priya Rao).
Compile competitor variant matrix by scraping docs + small API probes (owner: Mariana).
Synthesize prospectivity scoring rubric and validate with two SE pilots.
Prepare deliverables: micro-lens PDFs, interlock CSV, SE playbook, and an internal demo session.
Post-mortem and handoff to GTM + Solutions Templates repo.
